import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    t = [int(data[1 + 2 * i]) for i in range(n)]
    d = [int(data[2 + 2 * i]) for i in range(n)]
    full = 1 << n
    total = [0] * full
    dp = [0] * full
    for mask in range(1, full):
        low = mask & -mask
        j = low.bit_length() - 1
        total[mask] = total[mask ^ low] + t[j]
        best = None
        for k in range(n):
            if mask >> k & 1:
                cand = max(dp[mask ^ (1 << k)], total[mask] - d[k])
                if best is None or cand < best:
                    best = cand
        dp[mask] = best
    print(dp[full - 1])

main()
